title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN, November 2, 2026 - The President of Iran Masoud Pezeshkian made some remarks today.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN, November 2, 2026 - The President of Iran Masoud Pezeshkian made some remarks today."

"-------"

"SOT, Masoud Pezeshkian, President of Iran (Farsi): "We can emerge from all these threats he [Trump] is making, strong and powerful, and then he will realize that he is dealing with the people of Iran, not with me. For example, if he tries to assassinate me, then let him assassinate me, let him assassinate thousands of people like me. If the people are with us, they won't be able to do a damn thing.”
